svg.title: Suggest similar tickets while typing a new one — SoftTrack web design mockup (#95)
svg.desc: Once a new ticket’s title reaches about three words, the modal asks the existing search endpoint (debounced ~400 ms) and lists up to three matches under the title. No results, a short title or a failed request show nothing at all. A match opens in a new tab, so the draft stays.
